page: OVHcloud d2-4 is an entry-level virtual machine belonging to the Discovery family, designed for budget-conscious and lightweight workloads. Built on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture, this instance features 2 shared Intel vCPUs clocked at 2.0 GHz based on the Haswell microarchitecture. The hardware configuration is completed by 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core, and 50 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It does not include a dedicated GPU or high-speed baseline network bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned at the lower end of the spectrum. Stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, along with Passmark CPU scores, place the hardware in the bottom 10% of benchmarked servers. Memory bandwidth is similarly limited, with uncached read speeds at 19.19 GB/sec and write speeds at 14.22 GB/sec. Despite these constraints, the server achieves 2.07 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a static web serving throughput of 1.89 GB/sec.

Due to its shared CPU allocation and modest hardware profile, the d2-4 is highly cost-efficient for non-production environments. It is best suited for lightweight workloads such as basic web serving, development and testing environments, small database operations, or running simple background scripts. It is not designed for resource-intensive applications, large-scale LLM inference, or high-throughput networking.
